Nothing serious has happened yet... but there's something I'd like to ask of you.
strings.자네 혹시 아키시티라는 나라에 대해 알고 있나?: Have you heard of a country called Archi City?
I don't know much about it.
It's a dwarven kingdom on Merin Island.
Its second prince, Juan, is a close friend of mine.
We've known each other for quite a long time.
We correspond regularly, but this time I haven't heard a thing.
strings.근래에 마석 실험실 사건 때문에 아키시티에 변고가 일어났다는 이야기는 들: I heard that the recent incident at the Magic Stone Laboratory caused trouble in Archi City...
But with no word from Prince Juan, I'm terribly worried.
strings.제가 아키시티로 가서 정황을 살펴보고 오면 되는 건가요?: Would you like me to go to Archi City and see what's happening?
A spirited young dwarven woman named Dorun usually delivered our letters.
I wonder if something really has happened...
Well, it's been a long time.
strings.여긴 또 무슨 일이지? 사냥이라도 온 건가?: What brings you here again? Come to do some hunting?
No, I'm trying to get to Archi City, but I don't know the way.
Martelli asked me to go there on an errand.
Hmm. That could be dangerous. I hear things have been rather turbulent there lately.
They fought several battles against the artificial life-forms that escaped from the Magic Stone Laboratory...
And something seems to have gone wrong along the way.
Archi City's troops have been showing up here from time to time as well.
They've been searching the Magic Stone Laboratory like their lives depend on it...
You'd be better off staying away. Things are so tense that even I avoid the area.
I see. Even so, I think I should take a look for myself.
That's what Martelli asked me to do.
strings.아키시티는 메린섬 외곽에 있지. 섬을 쭉 가로질러 가봐. 아키시티가 보일: Archi City is on the edge of Merin Island. Go straight across the island and you'll see it.
Martelli sent me to see Prince Juan, but...
...They said it was dangerous. Perhaps I shouldn't have come.
Martelli... He's the one I was planning to visit.
Prince Hurin's faction despises humans, so you can't be one of their people...
strings.음, 저기 혹시 성함이 어떻게 되시죠?: Um, may I ask your name?
strings.마르텔리 님이, 후안 왕자님의 편지를 '도룬'이라는 드워프 아가씨가 전해: Martelli said that a dwarven woman named Dorun delivered Prince Juan's letters...
If you know that much, you must be...
Hmm. Still, I need to verify your identity properly...
strings.당신이 정말 후안 왕자님의 지기이신 마르텔리 님의 사람이라는 것을 증명해: Please prove that you really were sent by Martelli, Prince Juan's close friend.
You're back! I saw your exploits clearly with my own eyes.
Now I can trust that you aren't one of King Hurin's spies.
strings.그래서, 지금 아키시티 상황이 어떻게 된 거죠?: So what's going on in Archi City?
strings.왜 같은 드워프에게 공격을 받는 겁니까?: Why are other dwarves attacking you?
The truth is... His Majesty passed away recently.
strings.마석 실험실이라고 아십니까?: Have you heard of the Magic Stone Laboratory?
It's a laboratory built by the humans of Riveria to create artificial life-forms...
Monsters that escaped from it attacked Archi City.
His Majesty led the army to defend the kingdom, and in the battle...
The eldest prince, Hurin, ascended the throne, vowing revenge.
strings.그 과정에 리베라에 대한 공격을 말리시던 후안 왕자님을 감옥에 가두셨습니: In the process, he imprisoned Prince Juan for opposing an attack on Riveria.
Hurin has far too much confidence in Archi City's strength.
He's using revenge as a pretext for what is really a war of conquest.
strings.그러면 제가 후안 왕자님을 구출해 드리면 되는 건가요?: Then should I rescue Prince Juan?
Hurin has the key to his cell.
That means breaking through his heavily guarded army and defeating him.
That sounds a little difficult, but...
It's all right. I'll find a way.
I heard Hurin's personal machine boasted the very best performance...
Well, the armor was certainly tough.
It had quite a few interesting features too...
After defeating that incredible war machine, that's all you have to say...?
Compared to the enemies I'll be facing, that was nothing.
Anyway, now that I have the key, I'd better rescue Prince Juan.
strings.마지막까지 잘 부탁드립니다!: Please see this through to the end!
strings.열쇠를 획득했다는 것은… 형님을 쓰러뜨렸다고 봐도 되겠습니까?: If you obtained the key... may I assume you defeated my brother?
You could put it that way.
I owe both you and Martelli an enormous debt.
strings.이 후안, 죽을 때까지 잊지 않고 갚아 나가겠습니다!: I, Juan, will remember it and repay you for the rest of my life!
Thanks to you, I think convincing them will be easier.
I intend to persuade my brother's followers to change course.
strings.당신들을 쓰러뜨린 저 모험가를 보라!: Look at the adventurer who defeated you!
strings.저것이 바로 당신들이 우습게 보던 인간의 잠재력이다!: That is the potential of the humans you looked down on!
You couldn't even handle one of them and suffered such humiliation...
What disaster are you trying to bring upon us by talking of war?
We must be on friendly terms with them.
It's good to take pride in being dwarves, but we must abandon our stubborn arrogance.
We have much to learn from humans.
I will serve as a bridge between us.
We must seek progress through diplomacy, not war.
I'll help you see it through.
strings.왕자님을 구출해 주셔서 감사합니다!: Thank you for rescuing the prince!
strings.저도 이제 왕자님 곁으로 돌아가야겠습니다!: I must return to his side now!
There are still plenty of enemies who are hostile to us, so be careful.
And let me know if anything happens.
Now that we've met, I'll help however I can.
strings.포, 폭풍이 몰아치기 시작했습니다!: A-a storm has begun to rage!
A storm of emotion... Forgive me.
Anyway, I'll make sure to provide proper service right through to the end.
I'll secure an escape route. Head to Prince Juan when you see an opening.
What I thought was a simple favor turned into something far bigger.
I'm sorry. Please accept my apology.
We came dangerously close to a major war.
But Prince Juan made the right decision.
No matter how impressive their technology might be...
Going to war with Riveria would have been truly reckless.
I don't think we'd have lost even if we'd fought on our own, but...
The new mayor and the rest of the leadership are all clever people.
They would have asked our allies for help.
Prince Juan's judgment saved Archi City from disaster.
There should be an interesting round of diplomacy soon.
I have much to prepare, so please report to the mayor for me.
strings.그러고 보니 리베라의 신임 시장이 누구죠?: Come to think of it, who is Riveria's new mayor?
strings.우리를 이끌던 이가 누구였는지 기억나지 않나?: Don't you remember who led us?
strings.조만간 연락을 드리려고 했는데… 잘 오셨습니다!: I was planning to contact you soon... You've come at a good time!
There's so much work... I spend all my time signing paperwork.
strings.(에바에게 아키시티의 일을 말해준다.): (I tell Eva what happened in Archi City.)
Please leave the aftermath to me.
Thank you for saving Riveria from disaster once again.
How can we ever repay you...?
Take your time. You can repay me when things settle down.
You must be busy, so I'll be going...
